summary_en: 810,000 shares (12.0% of shares outstanding) to be acquired for up to ¥230M between 29 July and 31 August 2026, in addition to a prior buyback programme disclosed 18 June 2026. Subsequent cancellation to be decided after acquisition completion or window close. Method: ToSTNeT-3 (open market). Rationale: capital structure optimization, dividend reinstatement support, shareholder return enhancement.
title_en: Notice of Resolution on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On 29 July 2026, Saikaya Department Store's board resolved to acquire up to 810,000 treasury shares (12.0% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥230M during the period 29 July to 31 August 2026 via open-market purchase (ToSTNeT-3). This programme is additional to a prior buyback authorised on 18 June 2026. The company states that specific cancellation share numbers and dates will be announced separately after the acquisition window closes or acquisition is completed, following a further board resolution under the Companies Act Article 178.

The company cites capital structure optimisation, consideration of dividend reinstatement (a ¥5/share dividend is planned for the current fiscal year ending August 2026), and shareholder return expansion as rationale. The buyback is framed as part of responsive capital policy and shareholder return strategy alongside dividends.
